incumbent.config: maintained owner comparator, same13 inputs, conservative-count prompt

freshness: fresh uncached serial calls; no Attempt039 output reuse; no prompt/scorer/golden edits

stages.stop: must be terminal completed, exact served ID, valid usage/cost and strict integer schema; retain complete raw response before parse

stages.input: same generated synthetic case through owner provider adapter
stages.stop: same validity gates; compare request/schema and output capture topology

stages.selection: An effort is eligible only if both per-case assertions pass and both outputs are source-acceptable. Among eligible efforts, choose highest pair mean; if quality scores differ by <=0.01, choose the lower settled pair cost, then lower latency. Low may qualify; no rule requires a higher effort to beat fresh low. No pair-level >=0.95 gate.

stages.matrix: remaining maintained cases for the single selected effort only
stages.gate: combine with exposed pair; all13/13 case passes, overall >=.95, zero schema/provider errors; otherwise no comparator

stages.matrix: same all13 inputs with Gemini 3 Flash maintained configuration, only if Grok full13 gates pass
stages.stop: serial, usage/cost/latency captured; stop if remaining hard-cap reservation cannot be admitted

recovery_allowance.only: evidence-backed transport/operational faults; no semantic retries; every uncertain charge remains reserved until reconciled

reservation_policy.settlement: Reserve the full per-dispatch cap before each request. Only after complete valid usage/cost evidence settles may actual settled charge replace/release that request reservation. If no receipt/valid usage, preserve entire reservation as unresolved and stop or proceed only if remaining cap covers all pending reservations plus next dispatch.

candidate_limitations: All reasoning arms use max_output_tokens=8192; this differs from Attempt039 low max_output_tokens=2048, so any quality contrast is effort+new-output-budget configuration evidence, not a pure reasoning/checkpoint effect.

The exact production Gemini comparator has 1,048,576 input token and 65,536 model output limits; maintained owner config caps output at 16,384. Current official standard paid rates are $0.50/M input and $3/M output (model reasoning included in output), so worst per-call bound is $0.573440.
